claims: Every rank-3 matroid has compatible ordered basis-pair exchange diameter at most 3

correctness_evidence.method: separate exhaustive basis-axiom filter, exact compatibility-class exchange graphs, BFS, and independent simple-matroid canonicalization

prior_art_qualification.source: Kenji Kashiwabara, The Toric Ideal of a Matroid of Rank 3 is Generated by Quadrics, EJC 17 (2010) R28, DOI 10.37236/300
prior_art_qualification.coverage: Prior rank-3 White connectivity/reachability; does not supply the sharp universal distance bound 3 or the exact diameter spectrum.

originality_basis: The surviving novelty is the quantitative diameter<=3 theorem, the rank-3 case of Hamidoune's bounded exchange-distance conjecture, plus the exact small simple-matroid spectrum; checked literature states only rank-3 reachability or distance results for special classes.
value_reason: The sharp universal rank-3 metric theorem strengthens prior connectivity and provides an optimal structural base case for the broader symmetric-exchange distance program; the six-element finite check applies to arbitrary ground sets by support restriction.
